notes: The sidebar's Nearby Wi-Fi list no longer shows a never-ending "scanning…" when your Wi-Fi is actually off. It now tells you the truth: "Wi-Fi is off or disconnected", "No Wi-Fi adapter on this host", or "No nearby networks found".
It also re-scans every 15 seconds, so when you turn Wi-Fi back on the network list fills in on its own — no reload needed.
